findings.text: the predicate docstring says it answers false for a body carrying a status the reader recognises, but the implementation at line 168 answers false only for TERMINAL_MANIFEST_STATUSES, so a recognised non-terminal status and the unsubstituted status template both answer true; the template case is reachable because manifest_status_is_template sets manifest_unwritten at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:331.

the run's own 69-test cohort keeps this positive control failing at head and passing at base (subset-head.log 13 failed vs subset-base.log 12 failed, reproduced 3/3 at each arm), so the done_when item that the tests covering recovery_classification and recovery_liveness add no failures against the base is unmet on that evidence; the reviewer re-ran the test alone at head and it passed (1 passed in 4.90s), so it reads as a cohort-ordering interaction rather than a defect this node change introduces.

the done_when requires that ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths, and the run records no ruff run at all - no log on disk and no manifest line - so that item of the done_when is asserted rather than measured.
